title: oldenlandia monanthos

It is valued for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which have been shown to aid in the treatment of respiratory infections, fever, and inflammatory diseases. The therapeutic actions of Oldenlandia monanthos are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as phenolic acids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which work to modulate the immune system and reduce oxidative stress. The plant's bioactive constituents, including quercetin, kaempferol, and ursolic acid, have been found to exhibit anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory activities, contributing to its traditional use as a treatment for various health conditions.
